test.title: It is your farm-road T
test.hint: The farm road stays two-way across the near lane to a point between the lanes; rights cut at the mouth. PASS if it looks like yours.

test.title: Undo puts it back
test.hint: Press undo once. j06 is back as it was before the right-click. PASS if so. Redo if you want to keep it.
